executionModel.empiricalTargetMinutes: approximately 20-30 minutes for a competent coding agent; informational only because agents are not assumed to be time-aware
executionModel.sizingMechanism: bounded objective/non-goals/tasks/acceptance, not self-measured elapsed time
executionModel.phaseCompletionRule: complete/test/report/publish current phase, make only its immediate successor READY, then STOP
executionModel.repositoryAccess: local Git or GitHub connector are equivalent transports; published GitHub state is the durability boundary
executionModel.milestoneStatusRule: READY before first constituent phase starts; IN_PROGRESS after at least one constituent phase completes while another is active; COMPLETE only when all constituent phases complete; otherwise BLOCKED
